title: Pure Prediction Princess
summary: Aura Sentia's Prediction Princess Ritual and Flip control build, paired with high-impact Flip floodgates and Rank 9 Xyz bosses. Prediction Princess Tarotrei and Prediction Princess Tarotreith flip face-down monsters face-up or face-down as Quick Effects on either turn, firing floodgate Flip effects on command.

summary.title: Starters
points: Pre-Preparation of Rites adds both Prediction Ritual and Prediction Princess Tarotrei from the Deck or GY to the hand in a single card.

Prediction Princess Bibliomuse (Level 9 Flip) immediately revives itself in face-down Defense Position whenever it is Tributed and sent to the GY, and when flipped face-up it adds both a Prediction Princess monster and a Ritual Spell from the Deck to the hand.

Underworld Ritual of Prediction Ritual Summons Tarotrei or Tarotreith from the hand or GY in face-up Attack or face-down Defense Position, and banishes itself from the GY during the Standby Phase to Special Summon a non-Ritual Flip monster from the Deck face-down.

summary.title: Opening: Pre-Preparation of Rites + Bibliomuse
steps: Activate Pre-Preparation of Rites to add Prediction Ritual and Prediction Princess Tarotrei, then activate Prediction Ritual Tributing Level 9 Prediction Princess Bibliomuse from the hand to Ritual Summon Tarotrei.

Bibliomuse triggers in the GY to Special Summon itself face-down; use Tarotrei's Quick Effect to flip Bibliomuse face-up, searching Prediction Princess Tarotreith and Underworld Ritual of Prediction while giving your Ritual Monsters targeting and effect-destruction protection.
Activate Underworld Ritual of Prediction Tributing Bibliomuse (which revives itself face-down again) or let Tarotrei Special Summon Tarotreith from the hand or GY face-down during the End Phase.
Flip Tarotreith face-up to Special Summon Guard Dog, Whirlwind Weasel, Deus X-Krawler or Pot of The Forbidden from the Deck in face-down Defense Position, ready to flip on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Flip Floodgates & Payoffs
points: Guard Dog prevents the opponent from Special Summoning for the rest of the turn when flipped face-up during their Draw or Standby Phase, and Whirlwind Weasel locks them out of activating Spell or Trap Cards for the turn.
Deus X-Krawler (Level 9 Flip) continuously negates all monster effects activated on the opponent's field once it has been flipped face-up.

Pot of The Forbidden (Level 9 Flip) chooses one of four forbidden-card effects when flipped face-up: draw 2 cards, destroy all monsters the opponent controls, return all Spells and Traps on the field to the hand, or look at the opponent's hand and shuffle 1 card into the Deck.

summary.title: Extra Deck & Recursion
points: Subterror Behemoth Fiendess (Link-2) sends a Flip monster such as Bibliomuse or Pot of The Forbidden from the Deck to the GY to summon a Flip monster from the hand face-down, and searches a Flip monster when one she points to flips face-up.

Because Tarotrei, Tarotreith, Bibliomuse, Deus X-Krawler and Pot of The Forbidden are all Level 9, any two overlay into Phantom Fortress Enterblathnir (banishing from hand, field or GY) or Laevatein, Generaider Boss of Shadows (tributing itself to attach opposing cards under Jormungandr).
Prediction Ritual banishes itself from the GY on the next turn to search any Prediction Princess monster from the Deck.

main: Prediction Princess Tarotrei

Signature Level 9 LIGHT Fairy Ritual boss (2700 ATK): Quick Effect once per turn to change 1 face-down monster to face-up or vice versa; and during each End Phase, Special Summons 1 Flip monster from your hand or GY face-down!
Prediction Princess Tarotreith

Signature Level 9 DARK Fairy Ritual Flip boss: can be Ritual Summoned OR revived face-down by Tarotrei! When flipped face-up, Special Summons ANY Flip monster directly from your Deck face-down; Quick Effect to flip monsters face-up or face-down!
Prediction Princess Bibliomuse

Core Level 9 EARTH Fairy Flip engine: if Tributed and sent to GY, immediately Special Summons itself face-down; when flipped, adds 1 'Prediction Princess' monster AND 1 Ritual Spell from Deck to hand; makes Ritual Monsters immune to targeting and destruction!
Prediction Princess Coinorma
Level 3 EARTH Fairy Flip: when flipped, Special Summons 1 Level 3 or higher Flip monster from your hand or Deck in face-down Defense Position.
Prediction Princess Arrowsylph
Level 4 WIND Fairy Flip: when flipped, adds 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck or GY to your hand.
Pot of The Forbidden

Level 9 EARTH Rock Flip boss: when flipped face-up by Tarotrei or Tarotreith, activates Pot of Greed (Draw 2), Raigeki (wipe monsters), Giant Trunade (bounce Spells/Traps), OR The Forceful Sentry (peek and spin)!
Deus X-Krawler
Level 9 EARTH Insect Flip boss: once flipped face-up, negates all monster effects activated on your opponent's field!
Guard Dog
Level 3 EARTH Beast Flip monster: when flipped face-up during your opponent's turn, locks your opponent out of Special Summoning for the entire turn!
Whirlwind Weasel
Level 3 WIND Beast Flip monster: when flipped face-up during your opponent's turn, locks your opponent out of activating any Spell or Trap Cards for the entire turn!
Prediction Ritual

Core Ritual Spell: tributes monsters from hand/field totaling Level 9+ to Ritual Summon 'Prediction Princess Tarotrei'; banishes itself from GY to add ANY 'Prediction Princess' monster from Deck to hand!
Underworld Ritual of Prediction

Signature Ritual Spell: Ritual Summons ANY 'Prediction Princess' Ritual Monster from hand or GY face-up or face-down; banishes itself from GY during Standby Phase to Special Summon 1 non-Ritual Flip monster from Deck face-down!
Pre-Preparation of Rites
Adds both Prediction Ritual and Prediction Princess Tarotrei from your Deck or GY to your hand.
extra: Link-2 EARTH Wyrm: sends Bibliomuse or Pot of The Forbidden from Deck to GY to summon a Flip monster from hand face-down, and searches ANY Flip monster from Deck when a pointed monster flips face-up!
Rank 9 Xyz that detaches 1 material to banish 1 card from your opponent's hand, field, or GY.
Rank 9 Xyz that tributes itself as a Quick Effect to summon Jormungandr and attach opposing cards to it as material.
